metadata.execution_gold_boundary: Only execution_cases.prompt enters the user path; rubrics, IDs, labels, pattern and diagnostic expectations are never model input.

memory_seed.clock_basis: UTC for all fictional stored and requested times; the evaluation clock is independent of real device time.
memory_seed.confirmation: Every remember and correct operation is an explicitly confirmed fictional seed operation.

events.canonical_text: You call your neighbourhood sound archive Tideglass.
Selma is your sound-archive editor and helps you check recordings.
For sound-archive clips, you want filenames to start with the recording date followed by the street name.
You collect reserved library books from the lobby shelf.
Your spare transit card is inside the striped notebook.
Your temporary equipment locker number is 17.
Your community map session on 5 October 2026 starts at 14:00.
Your community map session on 5 October 2026 starts at 15:00.
The square hook beside the shed door is where you keep the watering-can key.
Your balcony rack holds fourteen seedling pots.
You keep the desktop fan off whenever the recording light is on.
Dalia's river-ferry ticket is valid for the upper deck.
Your allotment tap meter has 42 litres of prepaid water remaining.
You reserve 10 litres of the remaining allotment tap water for seedlings.
Your editing-booth booking on 4 October 2026 runs from 09:10 to 10:50.
Your audio-review call on 4 October 2026 begins at 10:30.
For cycle commutes, you allow at most two road crossings and choose the quickest route among those allowed.
You have five loan cameras ready for use.
You have three loan tripods ready for use.
Your clock-repair appointment on 6 October 2026 starts at 11:20.
For your display frames, you leave newly applied adhesive untouched for 25 minutes.
Your borrowed atlas is due back on 7 October 2026.
On 7 October 2026, your library book-returns desk closes at 18:15.
You started the photo scanning batch on 30 September 2026 at 23:40.
You finished the photo scanning batch on 1 October 2026 at 00:25.
The scanned-photo upload finished on 1 October 2026 at 01:05.
You recorded the Basin Road sound clip on 2 October 2026 at 07:35.
Your reserved library books are now collected at the side-window desk.
You applied adhesive to the delivery display frame on 3 October 2026 at 16:45.

expected_state.notes: The two map-session start times are separate current assertions, not a correction chain. The ferry ticket belongs to Dalia, not the user. Seed transitions happen before requests, so the evaluation tests a fixed lifecycle snapshot only.
